name: CYBR MATERIAL / Natural Detail and Wear
provenance: Ten original deterministic procedural materials. No source images, image generation, white-noise bump or upscaling. Not scans.

materials.name: Calacatta Oro / Weathered
materials.description: Ivory marble with a hierarchy of ragged mineral seams, fractured inclusions, crystalline intergrowth and shallow abrasion.

materials.name: Roman Travertine / Open Pore
materials.description: Vein-cut travertine with bed-clustered torn cavities, varied cavity floors, mineral laminae and fine calcite pores.

materials.name: American Walnut / Timeworn
materials.description: Procedural flat-sawn walnut sampled from a radial growth volume, with nonuniform annual rings, diffuse lumen windows, fine rays and shallow worn oil finish.

materials.name: Fumed Oak / Open Grain
materials.description: Procedural rift-cut fumed oak with growth-volume earlywood vessels, finite medullary ray plates, shallow lumen relief and worn low-gloss finish.

materials.name: Champagne Brass / Aged
materials.description: Aged brass with subdued tooling, localized abrasion bundles, granular tarnish fronts and small dielectric verdigris deposits.

materials.name: Blackened Steel / Worn
materials.description: Black oxide steel with directionally rubbed exposure, terraced rust crusts, corrosion pits and short abrasive score groups.

materials.name: Bone Porcelain / Crazed
materials.description: Ivory porcelain with a growing arrested crack network, subdued glaze ripples, pinholes and torn chips exposing the ceramic body.

materials.name: Saddle Leather / Used
materials.description: Cognac hide with soft stretched skin creases, fine follicles, compressed folds, burnished areas and grouped finish scuffs.

materials.name: Lime Plaster / Weathered
materials.description: Layered lime with overlapping trowel passes, directional leading lips, exposed angular aggregate, delamination and fine pinholes.

materials.name: Natural Linen / Frayed
materials.description: Fine plain flax weave with 120 variable yarns per tile, continuous over-under bending, fibrils, attached slubs and real transparent inter-yarn openings.
